s.note: the toasts at Lillian's engagement party
s.how: Take 150g brie, 150g aged cheddar and 100g blue cheese out an hour ahead. Toast 80g walnuts at 170C for 8 minutes. Arrange with grapes and crackers and drizzle honey over the blue.

s.note: Annie's bakery that didn't make it
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 50g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and 1 tbsp cinnamon. Roll, cut 12 and prove 30 minutes. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes and ice with 100g cream cheese beaten with icing sugar.

m.note: the trip to Vegas that never makes it past the plane
m.how: Simmer 2 tins crushed tomatoes with 3 sliced garlic cloves and chilli flakes for 20 minutes. Cook 500g rigatoni 2 minutes short and finish it in the sauce. Tear 2 burrata over the top with basil just before serving.

w.note: the one cupcake she makes alone late at night
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and vanilla bean seeds, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 170C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites and 120g sugar over hot water, beat in 200g butter, tint pale pink and pipe tall. Add a fondant flower.

d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne in an ice bucket for 30 minutes. Drop a raspberry into each of four flutes and pour slowly over the top.
